err_sp_download_fail: Difunda diakajika. Tangila tshiamu tshia USB ne tshibuelelu ne tshiamu tshia batterie, pashishe teta kabidi.
err_sp_enable_dram: Tshiamu etshi katshivua mua kutuadija lungenyi lua muena manaya to. Ingidija tshibuta tshienza bua tshilejelu etshi menemene.

retry_guidance_step_2: 2. Fina butone bua kupingaja malu budi busokoka ne tshiamu tshia kukanga nabi mabeji anyi tshiamu tshia ku matshi.
retry_guidance_step_3: 3. Ela kabidi tshiamu tshia USB, pashishe teta kabidi.

1. Sungula 'USB Storage Mode' pa tshiamu tshieba tshia kuteleja natshi.
2. Fina pa 'Tangila tshilaminu...' bua kusungula tshiamu tshieba ne kuteka biena-bualu.

rockbox_themes_notice_body: Rockbox on Y1 no longer supports iPod classic (240p) themes from Rockbox.org. You'll have to use 360p Rockbox themes made for Y1. Click next to continue.
rockbox_troubleshoot_desc: Shi {model} webe kena utuadija, umbusha USB, uteke butone bua nzembu bua 10s bua kupingaja, ne enza mudimu. Anyi kupingaja programe ya ntuadijilu.
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: Tshiamu etshi tshidi tshikeba dipetangana dia ADB (too ne mu sekonde 30). Shi tshiamu kampanda tshipeta, biena-bualu bidi bishintuluka ne tshiamu tshia kuteleja natshi tshidi tshituadija tshiakabidi. Shi ki mmuomu, ndaku ku USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_found: Tshiamu tshipeta ({serial}); kufila mitu ya malu...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: Dituma dia ADB diakapanga; kupingana ku mushindu wa kulama bintu wa USB
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Kutuma mitu ya malu ne maleta pa mutu pa ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_searching: Kuindila tshiamu tshia ADB... (kufika ku tusunsa 30)
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Kakuena tshiamu tshia ADB tshidibu bapeta mu masekonde 30 to; kutungunuka ne mushindu wa kulama bintu wa USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Tshitupa 2: Kukeba muena manaya pa mutu pa ADB...
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Pano udi mua kumbusha tshiamu tshia kuteleja natshi ne kusungula tshiena bualu mu Rockbox (Malongolola > Malongolola a tshiena bualu).
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Kakuena binary wa ADB udiku mu app to; kutungunuka ne mushindu wa kulama bintu wa USB.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Umbusha tshiamu tshia USB.
2. Pingaja tshiamu tshia manaya ne utshilekele tshibuela mu Rockbox.
3. Padi Rockbox wenda wenza mudimu, ela tshiamu tshia USB, pashishe ufina pa Continue.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Kuata buto bua kutemesha tshiamu tshieba, ela kabidi USB, ne usungula USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Kuata butone bua munkatshi bua kuenza mudimu ne Y1 webe, ela kabidi USB, ne usungula USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Tshitupa 1: Tuadija kabidi tshiamu tshia kuteleja natshi ne udisangishe kabidi
rockbox_wizard_skip_adb: Tangila mu mushindu wa kulama bintu wa USB
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Enza bua USB Storage Mode ikale pa tshiamu tshia kuteleja natshi bua tshimueneke bu tshiamu tshia mashinyi.
2. Sungula tshilaminu tshionso tshidi pa tshiamu tshia kuteleja natshi tshidi kuinshi eku (.rockbox, Music, Themes, anyi muji wa tshiamu, tshilaminu tshia .rockbox tshisokoka tshidi tshimueneka nkayatshi).
3. Tshiamu etshi tshidi tshisangisha mitu ya malu ne maleta a 360p, tshifunda pa mutu pa mikanda idi ne dina dimue.

sel_multiple_scatters_error: Bintu bia bungi bia firmware anyi bipese bia scatter bivua bipetekibua mu tshilaminu etshi. Sungula tshilaminu anyi tshilaminu tshidi anu ne tshiamu tshimue tshia mudimu musangu umua.
sel_multiple_scatters_release_error: Tshibejibeji etshi tshidi ne mikanda mipite pa umue, nunku Updater kena mua kuamba mushindu kayi udi player webe dijinga to. Muenji wa {software} udi ne tshia kuakaja programe wende bua kubueja anu tshikandakanda tshimue tshia scatter.
sel_multiple_scatters_title: Bintu bia bungi bia Firmware mbipeta

sel_offline: Malu adibu bafunda ku Enternete kaenaku mpindieu to. Wenza mudimu ne mukanda wa muaba uudi, anyi tangila dipetangana diebe.
sel_offline_install: Teka tshiamu tshia mudimu tshia .zip anyi .rar pa Innioasis anyi Timmkoo audio player.
sel_offline_install_generic: Ela tshiamu tshia mudimu mu tshilaminu tshia .zip/.rar anyi mu tshilaminu tshia tshiamu tshia mudimu pa biamu bia MediaTek bia pa tshibidilu.
sel_only_local: Sungula tshiamu tshia .zip anyi .rar tshia muaba uudi, anyi tshilaminu / scatter .txt, bua kutshiteka pambelu pa Enternete, kakuyi dijinga ne internet to. Udi wenza mudimu ne tshiamu tshionso tshia Innioasis ne Timmkoo.
sel_only_local_generic: Sungula tshiamu tshia mudimu (.zip, .rar) anyi tshilaminu tshidi ne tshikandakanda tshia scatter bua kutshiteka pambelu pa internet, tshidi tshienza mudimu ne biamu bia MediaTek bia pa tshibidilu.
sel_prompt_need_firmware: Sungula .zip, .rar archive, anyi scatter file (*scatter*.txt) munda mua tshilaminu tshia firmware bua kuteka firmware uudi musungule pa {target} webe.
sel_source_desc: Teleja tshiamu tshia mashinyi ku Enternete, anyi ufila tshintu tshia muaba uudi musombele.
sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Tuasakidila bua kupatula USB, kutemesha ne kubuela mu Rockbox musangu umua (bua yeye kutuadija tshilaminu tshia munda tshia .rockbox), pashishe kupingaja USB ne kusungula 'USB Storage Mode'.

Paudi mubueja, tuaku pa Tungunuka bua kusungula tshilaminu tshionso tshia tshiamu tshieba.
sel_themepack_guidance_title: Lamakaja Player mu mushindu wa kulama bintu wa USB
sel_themepack_prompt_body: Udi muele 360p Rockbox build. Udi musue kuteka 360p Theme Pack pa tshiamu etshi mpindieu anyi?
sel_themepack_prompt_title: Udi mua kuteka Rockbox 360p Theme Pack anyi?

sel_themepack_success: Rockbox Theme Pack mulongolola bimpa pa tshiamu tshieba!
sel_type_help_body:
Teta tshiamu tshia mudimu tshia Type A kumpala.

Shi tshiamu tshieba tshia kubandila natshi katshiyi tshienza mudimu kunyima kua diteka, ela umue wa ku mishindu ya Type B.

Biamu bia mushindu wa B ke bidi bilua ne mishindu ya firmware kumpala kua 2.0.
sel_type_help_tooltip: Teta tshiamu tshia mudimu tshia Type A kumpala. Shi tshiamu tshieba tshia kubandila natshi katshiyi tshienza mudimu kunyima kua diteka, ela umue wa ku mishindu ya Type B. Biamu bia mushindu wa B ke bidi bilua ne mishindu ya firmware kumpala kua 2.0.

settings_240p_tip: Udi uleja bintu bidi ne ROM zip wa 240p (rom..._240p.zip). 240p builds kayena ipetangana na Y1 units pa Innioasis OS muinshi mua 3.0.7, nunku Show Old Rockbox Builds udi muenza nende mudimu.
settings_add_device_no_versions: Kakuena mishindu ya tshiamu etshi idiku mpindieu to.
settings_add_device_type_hint: Mushindu i tshintu tshia tshiamu tshia muena manaya. Bantu badi benza manaya a mushindu umua badi mua kuenza mu mishindu mipite pa umue — tshilejilu Type A ne Type B — ne programe udi muenza bua umue wa kudibu. Tangila tshimanyishilu tshidi kunyima kua tshiamu tshia manaya; shi kena utela dina dia mushindu, shiya disungula dia kumpala.
settings_advanced_desc: Ileja mushindu wa kuteka, mushindu wa kuteka ne mishindu ya kupatula.
settings_allow_keep_data_any: Witabije bua kulama malu ne bintu bia kumanyisha nabi pa tshiamu tshionso tshidibu bateka
settings_allow_keep_data_any_desc: Udi ulekela lukonku lua diumvuangana. Enza mudimu ne bualu ebu anu paudi mujadike ne: tshiamu tshia manaya netshitungunuke ne kuenza mudimu ne malu adibu balongolole ne biamu bia mudimu.
settings_arm64_driver_note: Dikuatshisha dia ARM64 Windows kadiena diteta to. Pa biamu bia mudimu bia Snapdragon ne RTX Spark, Zadig udi mua kuenza mudimu ne Driver Signature Enforcement mupangisha bua kuteka WinUSB anyi libusb bua tshiamu tshia MT6227 Preloader mu Device Manager. Tangila mukanda wa ARM64 bua kumanya malu adibu ne bua kuenza.
settings_cache_desc: Butula bintu bia tshiamu tshia mashinyi ne bipese bia ROM bua kupeta muaba wa diske. Malu eba a kale a diteka dia bintu ne malu audi musue bua kuvuluija malu adibu bashintulule mmalama.
settings_checker_desc: Udi ulongolola ordinatere webe bua kulamakaja ku tshiamu tshiebe tshia manaya ne kuteka bintu bipiabipia bia programe mu mushindu muimpe.
settings_checker_desc_advanced: Udi utangila bulongolodi bua Linux bua SP Flash Tool, mushindu wa kubuela mu USB, bukenji bua mulongolongo, ne bintu bia mu tshiamu.
settings_checker_desc_friendly: Udi ulongolola ordinatere webe bua kulamakaja ku tshiamu tshiebe tshia manaya ne kuteka bintu bipiabipia bia programe mu mushindu muimpe.
settings_checker_desc_installer: Udi ulongolola ordinatere webe bua kulamakaja ne tshiamu tshiebe tshia manaya bua kupeta malu mapiamapia a programe.
settings_driver_desc: Kumpala kua kuenza mudimu ne programe eu bua musangu wa kumpala, udi ne bua kuela tshiamu tshia MediaTek USB, pashishe kutuadija kabidi ordinatere webe.
settings_drivers_gate_body: Kuteka tshiamu tshia MediaTek USB ntshienzedi tshia musangu umua, ne Windows udi ubiangata anu kunyima kua dijadikulula. Too ne bionso bibidi bimane kujika, tshiamu etshi tshidi mua kubenga kupeta tshiamu tshiebe tshia manaya padi tshiamu tshituadija.

settings_notifications_unavailable: Mamanyisha a tshiamu kaenaku mu ordinatere ewu to.
settings_offline_mode_desc: Sokoka tshilaminu tshia bintu bia pa buloba ne uteke programe anu mu mikanda ya muaba unudi.
settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Dipatuka dia Rockbox-Y1 kumpala kua 0.5 kadiena dikumbanangana ne Y1 idibu bapane kunyima kua ngondo muisatu 2026 ne Innioasis OS 3.0.7 muteka kumpala to.

Kuela tshiamu tshia kale pa biamu ebi nekupangishe bua kutuadija mudimu.

Udi mujadike ne udi musue kuleja bintu bia kale bia Rockbox anyi?
settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
Biamu bia mudimu bia kale bipite pa 3.0.7 kabiena bikumbanangana ne Y1 idibu bapanyisha ne Innioasis OS 3.0.7 to. Kuela tshiamu tshia kale pa bintu ebi nekubipangishe bua kutuadija mudimu too ne padibu bapingaja tshiamu tshipiatshipia.

Udi mujadike ne udi musue kuleja bintu bia kale bia kale kupita 3.0.7 anyi?

settings_rockbox_desc: Udi wenza mudimu padibu batangila bintu bidi bipatuka.
settings_run_as_admin_desc: Lomba Windows bukenji bua mulombodi padi tshiamu tshituadija. SP Flash Tool ne MTKClient badi benza mudimu ne bukenji buonso, njila wa kujikija lutatu padi muendeshi anyi tshiibi tshibenga kunzulula.
settings_run_as_admin_restart_needed: Updater CE udi ne tshia kutuadija kabidi bua kuenza mudimu ne bukenji ebu.
settings_run_as_admin_unavailable: Tshiamu etshi katshiena ne tshiamu tshia kuambuluisha natshi bua kubandila to.
settings_run_as_superuser_desc: Enza mudimu ne bukokeshi bua miji kupitshila ku pkexec. Wenza nayi mudimu padi tshilema tshia bukenji tshipangisha tshiamu tshia mudimu tshia flash.
settings_run_in_background_desc_menu_bar: Lama programe mu kazubu ka menu kunyima kua dididishi dimane kujika, nunku udi anu upeta mamanyisha a dishintulula dia programe ne tshiamu tshia manaya. Off: kukanga dididishi kudi kupatuka mu app.
settings_run_in_background_desc_system_t: Lama programe mu tshiamu tshia mashinyi kunyima kua dididishi dimane kujika, nunku udi anu upeta mamanyisha a dishintulula dia programe ne tshiamu tshia manaya. Off: kukanga dididishi kudi kupatuka mu app.
settings_run_in_background_group: Enza mudimu kunyima bua kupeta mamanyisha
settings_skip_install_donations: Lekela dilomba dia dipa dia panyima pa diteka dia bintu
settings_skip_install_donations_tip: Leja malu mapepele a kujikija kuyi ulomba mapa kunyima kua dilengeja.
settings_sp_auth_desc: Udi mua kusungula kuenze anyi to. Bamue bantu ba MediaTek badi babenga kuenza mudimu too ne padi SP Flash Tool upeta mukanda wa dianyisha (.auth); ela tshieba apa pikala tshiamu tshikengela.
settings_sp_gui_desc: Udi ukanga Updater CE ne udi unzulula SP Flash Tool GUI ne tshikandakanda tshia firmware tshisungula ne bimfuanyi bia dikosolola bimane kulongolola.
settings_sp_gui_install: Teka mu SP Flash Tool GUI
settings_terminal_desc: Udi wenza mudimu ne diteka dia programe webe mu Terminal bua wewe kumona malu a tekiniki adi atangila mudimu udi wenzeka.
settings_terminal_desc_windows: Udi wenza mudimu ne programe webe mu Command Prompt bua wewe kumona malu a tekiniki adi atangila mudimu udi wenda.
settings_themes_refresh_done: Mitu ya malu ne maleta bidi bipiabipia.
settings_themes_refresh_failed: Kavua mua kupingaja to; mitu ya malu milama itshidiku.
settings_themes_refreshing: Mukanda wa tshiena bualu udi ulengeja...
settings_track_multiple_desc: Keeps a record of every release installed on the same model. With more than one on record the app cannot tell your players apart, so an install asks which software is running and whether to keep your settings and media. Player update reminders keep working as usual.

support_methods_subtitle: Sungula mushindu uudi musue kufila mapa. Dipa dionso didi difila makuta bua kuangata bintu, kulama ne kuteta bintu bia mudimu.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis utu upatula pa tshibidilu biamu bia mudimu bipiabipia bua bena manaya bu mudi Y1 (bidi bitangila malu adibu bashintulule bu mudi 6.0, 7.0, ne 8.0) bidi bishipa biamu bia kale mu tshimpitshimpi. Tshidi tshibi menemene, site wabu kena ufila didimuija nansha dimue ne kena ufila mushindu wa kupeta bintu bia kale bivua bienza mudimu bua kupingana ku nsombelu mubi to. Updater CE ne Community Firmware project badi bangata bitupa: tudi tulama ROM yonso wa kale, tujadika diakamue dishintulula dia tshiamu tshieba, ne tuenza bua tshiamu tshieba tshienze mudimu bimpe.
support_story_1_headline: Padi benji ba bintu baya kumpala, bena mutumba badi baya kumpala.
support_story_1_item_1: Kusungila bena manaya badi banyanguke: Dikonkonona dia malu a bukubi didi dijadika ne: bintu bipiabipia kabiena mua kunyanga bintu bia kale to.
support_story_1_item_2: ROMs ya tshibutshilu: Tshisangilu tshijima tshia firmware ya tshiapu tshia Innioasis tshijimija.
support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: Biamu bia mudimu bia macOS, Linux, ne Windows.
support_story_1_item_4: Lungenyi lua bintu: Dijingulula dia tshiamu tshia mashinyi bua wewe kupeta misangu yonso tshintu tshimpe.
support_story_1_lead: Kukuba tshiamu tshieba ku mateyi a tshiamu tshia mudimu tshidi katshiyi tshiumvuika ne ku malu adibu bashintulule.
support_story_2_body: Kulonda programe wa Innioasis wa mbulamatadi kudi kumvuija kukeba mu forums bua kupeta ma link a Google Drive adi mafue, Baidu cloud shares, ne zip ya malu adi kaayi malelela kayiyi ne biamu bia mudimu. Tuakalongolola tshiamu tshia kueyemena, tshia pa nkayatshi tshia diangatshila bintu ne bulelela bua SHA-256, mamanyisha a malu mapiamapia, ne dilongolola dia malu ku kakese ku kakese. Mapa eba adi alama buludiludi bintu bia kuangata ne bia kulama bidi bienza bua bualu ebu buenzeke mêba 24 ku dituku, matuku 365 ku tshidimu.
support_story_2_headline: Kakuena tshiamu tshia Google tshinyanguke to. Kakuyi mudimu wa diela meji. Anu firmware udi wenza mudimu.
support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: Lubilu, dikoka dia buludiludi kakuyi mikalu ya dikopolola anyi njila mifue.
support_story_2_item_2: Dimanyisha dia malu mapiamapia: Ikala mumanyishibua dîba didibu bapatula bintu bipiabipia anyi malu adibu balongolole.
support_story_2_item_3: Diteka dia bintu mu tshitupa ku tshitupa: Bintu bidi bimueneka patoke bidi bikulombola mu difina dia buto.
support_story_2_item_4: Tshisumbu tshia bantu badi bakula miakulu ya bungi: Mu Anglais, tshiena-Chine, tshiena-Allemand, tshiena-Espagne, tshiena-France ne tshiena-Japon.
support_story_2_lead: Lubilu lua bungi, bintu bia mudimu bia mu tshisumbu bijadika biudi mua kueyemena.
support_story_3_body: Programe ya mu tshiapu tshia bintu idi anu ikosa pa mutu pa tshidi tshiamu tshieba tshia Y1 anyi Y2 mua kuenza. Tshisumbu tshietu tshiakafila Rockbox, biamu bia mudimu bipepele, dinaya dia codec dia audiophile, ne biena-bualu bia pa buabi. Tudi tusumba mishindu ya bintu bia mudimu ku tshibombi bua kuteta, kushintulula, ne kujadika diteka dionso. Kukuatshisha Updater CE kudi kufila makuta buludiludi bua biamu bia diteta ebi ne kukolesha dienza dia programe wa tshiamu tshia mashinyi.
support_story_3_headline: Kukangula bukole buonso bua tshiamu tshieba tshia Innioasis.
support_story_3_item_1: One-Click Rockbox: Dibala dia malu a kuteleja ne biena-bualu bia pa buabi bidibu bateka mu masekonde makese.
support_story_3_item_2: Tshiamu tshia mudimu tshia bena mu tshisumbu: Dilengeja dia bateri, tshiamu tshia mudimu tshikezuke, ne diambuluisha dia codec wa mêyi wa matuku etu aa.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Tudi tuteta pa biamu bia bushuwa kumpala kua kupatula tshiamu nansha tshimue.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% ya tshianana, programe wa malu masokoka udi kayi ne mamanyisha anyi dilonda.
support_story_3_lead: Kufila Rockbox, mishindu ya mudimu mipepele, ne budikadidi bua bantu badi basue kuteleja.
support_story_4_body: Padi tshiapu tshia bintu bia mudimu tshiya ku tshiamu tshiabu tshikuabu, biamu bia kale bidi bilekela. Innioasis kena ufila diambuluisha dia Linux, kena ufila mashintuluka adi amueneka patoke, ne kena ne mushindu mupepele wa kupingaja padi dilongolola dipanga to. Updater CE udiku bualu bena mudimu badi ne lukunukunu kabena ne tshia kuela tshiamu tshia mijiki tshimpe to. 100% ya mapa a bena musoko adi aya buludiludi bua kulama tshiamu etshi tshiunzulula kudi muntu yonso.
support_story_4_headline: Tuambuluishe bua kuenza tshidi Innioasis kayi wenza.
support_story_4_item_1: Disungila ne diunzulula: Dipingaja dia bintu didi dijadika nansha padi biamu bibenga kuenza mudimu.
support_story_4_item_2: Dikuatshisha dia mulongo wa kumpala dia Linux: MediaTek udi ukuatshisha bimpe pa biamu bia Linux.
support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Mifundu ya malu adibu bapatule bua wewe kumanya bimpe malu adibu bashintulule.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Community Funded: Kafe konso kadi kalama tshilaminu tshia bintu tshiunzulula ne tshia tshianana kudi bantu bonso.
support_story_4_lead: Dilama dia tshiamu tshia mashinyi tshidi tshienzeja kudi bena mutumba tshidi tshilama biamu biebe pambelu pa miaba idibu bumbuisha bintu bia bukoya.

1. Ela tshiamu tshieba tshia mudimu pa kukuata butone bua Power.
2. Padi Rockbox ubanga, ela tshiamu tshia USB mu ordinatere webe.
3. Shi udi ulomba ku tshiamu tshia kuteleja natshi, jadika mushindu wa kulama bintu bia USB bua tshiamu tshimueneke bu tshiamu tshia mashinyi.
